items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I left Andy shortly after that, and went with Georgie Auld's band.

ctx.x: No, he wouldn't go South. He wouldn't go South. I had an incident there with Georgie Auld about that shit, though...
Well, we'll get to that later. But I guess Charlie was one of the White bands that played the Apollo, because I remember hearing him there.
